title: Accounts: sign in, keys that follow you, remote access control, bug reports
notes:
- Sign in with email + password (create the account inside the app). Access is confirmed with the AI Portal server at launch and every 6 h, and keeps working 7 days offline after the last confirmation
- Your API keys travel with the account: encrypted on your machine with your password (AES-GCM) before upload — the server only ever stores ciphertext. Saved keys land on every machine you sign in to
- Report a bug from the account menu: what happened, the last generation trace (settings + timings, no images), an optional screenshot, and your prompt only when you tick it
- Anonymous usage and crash data helps fix bugs fast — opt-in at sign-in, switchable any time in the account menu; never prompts, images or keys
- Every generating route now requires a signed-in, active account
- Confirming a new account and resetting a password happen inside the app with a 6-digit code from the email — no links, nothing opens in a browser. Password fields have an eye to show what you typed
- The app checks in every 5 minutes: a required update, a message from AI Portal or a paused account reaches every open app within minutes
